<thought>Based on the dominant m/z 262.0994 peak (likely [M+H]+), the neutral mass is ≈261.092 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈20 % M+1, ≈2 % M+2) matches a molecule with about 18 carbons and no hetero‑atoms that give strong isotopic signatures. A formula C₁₈H₁₃O₂ gives a monoisotopic mass of 261.092 Da and reproduces the observed isotope intensities, so it is the most plausible molecular formula.</thought>
<final_answer>C18H13O2</final_answer>
